querySettings.query:
Select 
distinct a.CUSTOMER_ID as CustometID,
a.NAME as CustomerName,
case when a.CUSTOMER_ID in ( 'CS0193', 'CS0371') then 'REST OF THE WORLD' when b.CF$_REGION_DESCRIPTION is null then 'ASIA PACIFIC' else b.CF$_REGION_DESCRIPTION end as Region,
a.COUNTRY as CountryName,
a.CF$_CUSTOMER_CATEGORY as CustomerSegment
from ifsapp.customer_info_cfv a left join
(select distinct IDENTITY,cf$_region_description from ifsapp.customer_order_inv_join_cfv where cf$_region_description is not null) b
on a.CUSTOMER_ID = b.IDENTITY where  
  (COUNTRY = 'SRI LANKA' or a.CUSTOMER_ID  in ('CS0371', 'CS0193'))
 and a.CF$_CUSTOMER_CATEGORY  is not null
union all 
Select 
distinct a.CUSTOMER_ID as CustometID,
a.NAME as CustomerName,
'ASIA PACIFIC' as Region,
a.COUNTRY as CountryName,
a.CF$_CUSTOMER_CATEGORY as CustomerSegment
from ifsapp.customer_info_cfv a  where  
  a.CUSTOMER_ID  = 'CS0286'
